name: odf
comment: Hand written, not generated by tools/sync_catalog.py: ODF's gather is a
openshift-layout named_resources arrays the sync tool parses. The plugins
below are the leaf gather_* scripts; the default set matches gather_main
(what runs when you pass no flags to /usr/bin/gather).
Unlike openshift/must-gather there is no common.sh: --since is applied via
utils.sh parse_since_time → LOG_FILTER_ARGS / JCTL_FILTER_ARGS, and there

profile.noop_pattern: [Ss]kipping|[Nn]ot (detected|found|present)|exiting|Scale cluster CRDs not detected|Storage Cluster is not present|NAMESPACES is empty

namespaced.description: Namespaced ODF/OCS resources in the operator and product namespaces (storage CRs, objectbuckets, …). Upstream flag: -ns / --namespaced; also part of -o / --odf.

clusterscoped.description: Cluster-scoped storage objects: PVs, storageclasses, CSI drivers, SCCs, volume replication/snapshot classes, nodes. Upstream flag: -cs / --clusterscoped; also part of -o / --odf.

noobaa.description: MultiCloud Gateway / NooBaa: noobaa CRs, backingstores, bucketclasses, OBCs, and noobaa CLI status. Upstream flag: -n / --noobaa.

ceph_logs.description: Ceph daemon, CSI, kernel, journal and crash logs from debug pods on worker nodes. Upstream flag: -cl / --ceph-logs; also part of -o / --odf.

ceph.description: Ceph commands and pod logs (gather_ceph_resources / gather_common_ceph_resources). Skips or limits collection for external and MCG-only clusters. Upstream flag: -c / --ceph; also part of -o / --odf.

dr.description: Regional disaster recovery namespaces and resources (openshift-dr-system, …). No-ops when no DR namespaces exist. Upstream flag: -d / --dr.

provider.description: ODF client / provider-consumer: ocs-client-operator namespaces, storageclients, storageclaims, CSI driver state. Upstream flag: -pc / --provider.

cnsa.description: IBM Spectrum Scale (CNSA) nested must-gather. Exits without collecting when Scale CRDs are absent. Upstream flag: -cn / --cnsa.

minimal.description: Small set of storagecluster-related CRs and CSVs for a quick look. Upstream flag: -m / --minimal.
